basic_info.description: Welcome to 81 Frank Norris Street #501! Hovering above the hustle and bustle of the city and filled with light, this spectacular residence offers all the gracious conveniences of modern living inside a beautiful and well-appointed home. With one large bedroom and one full bath this bright corner unit feels light and airy.  Included is separate secure storage and a LARGE deeded parking space.  Centrally located in at the intersection of Civic Center/Van Ness and Nob Hill neighborhoods, this home is eminently walkable to a wide array of shopping and restaurants - Le Marais Bakery, Swan Oyster Depot, etc. and conveniently located 2-3 blocks from both Trader Joes and Whole Foods.  Come check out Frank Norris - a wonderful place to start (or continue) your San Francisco story!
